description:
Make named child selection coherent and immediately usable by replacing orchestrate's misleading `role` selector with the same canonical `agent` concept already used by `spawn`, then ship bundled `worker` and `investigate` definitions.

## Background

`orchestrate.tasks[].role` is described as an open string but is actually validated against discovered agent/template names. This causes callers to pass semantic values such as `worker` and receive `unknown role`. Internally the same concept is duplicated as `agent`, `agentName`, and `role`, while `taskType` is the genuinely separate workflow-policy selector.

## Contract lock

- Public canonical field: `agent` on both `spawn` and `orchestrate` task descriptors.
- `taskType` remains unchanged and separate.
- This is a clean early-version cutover: remove `role` from provider-visible schemas, runtime metadata, tree fields, packet/inspection fields, skill/prompt copy, tests, and docs. Do not carry dual stored fields or a permanent compatibility wrapper.
- If historical process-local metadata contains `role`, it need not be promoted into a durable compatibility contract; restarted running children are already aborted.
- An `agent` value is a discovered agent/template name, not an arbitrary semantic label. Unknown names reject with actionable guidance to call `list_agents`.

## Built-in agents

Add package-owned, lowest-precedence definitions:

- `worker`: routine scoped implementation, equivalent in behavior to the current `general-coder` guidance—implement end to end, follow repository patterns, avoid unrelated cleanup, verify, report files/validation/risk. Use medium thinking. Do not hardcode a provider/model; inherit the parent unless overridden.
- `investigate`: evidence-first investigation. Default to no project mutation; it may modify only when the complete child task explicitly requests implementation. Require repository evidence, clear uncertainty, referenced paths, and concise findings. Use high thinking. Do not silently turn investigation into implementation.

Discovery precedence is `built-in < user < project`; same-name user/project definitions override the built-in. `list_agents`/`list_minion_types` must expose source and effective definitions clearly. Extend `AgentSource` or equivalent rather than pretending built-ins are ephemeral files.

## Scope / likely files

- `packages/pi-minions/src/types.ts`, `agents.ts`, `minions.ts`, `tree.ts`
- `tools/orchestrate.ts`, spawn/orchestrate schemas and metadata propagation
- lifecycle packets, inspection tools, communication peer metadata, renderers
- `index.ts`, `skill.ts`, README, and Beadwork prompt terminology where it explains agent vs taskType
- focused fixtures/tests across spawn, orchestrate, tree, packets, inspection, agent discovery, and cross-package prompt assertions

## Acceptance behavior

- `spawn({ agent: "worker" })` and `orchestrate({ tasks: [{ agent: "worker", ... }] })` resolve through one loader.
- `investigate` works with no user agent directory.
- Project `worker` overrides user `worker`; user `worker` overrides built-in `worker`.
- Unknown `agent` rejection identifies the bad value and directs the caller to `list_agents`; it does not suggest the closed `taskType` list.
- `taskType` still selects parent nudge policy and never collapses into agent selection.
- Inspection, packets, peer lists, logs, and docs consistently say `agent`, with no live `role` field remaining.
- Existing foreground spawn behavior, orchestrated communication-tool boundaries, thinking metadata, and completion-nudge precedence remain intact.

## Tests

Add regression coverage for built-in discovery without filesystem setup, precedence overrides, both public tools resolving the same definition, unknown-agent diagnostics, schema removal of `role`, metadata round-trip, taskType/nudge separation, and the worker/investigate prompt mutation boundaries. Update deterministic Beadwork/minions integration fixtures to use `agent`.

Run:
- `npm run lint -w @solvedbydev/pi-minions`
- `npm run test -w @solvedbydev/pi-minions`
- `npm run typecheck -w @solvedbydev/pi-minions`
- scoped Beadwork tests/typecheck affected by prompt/schema terminology

Commit atomically with this issue id.

comments.text: Independent review of cbeb998 PASSed production behavior but found two test-proof gaps. Parent adjudication: (1) builtin spawn/orchestrate tool-path tests depending on real user-home agent discovery is FIX/blocking because the ticket explicitly requires deterministic built-in resolution without filesystem setup and the test can fail when a developer has worker.md/investigate.md; remediate before closure. (2) no explicit regression proving a legacy extra `role` key is ignored rather than selected is FILE/nonblocking in isolation, but fold it into the same focused test fix because it directly locks the clean-cutover boundary. Reviewer correctly REJECTED adding `additionalProperties: false`: `role` is absent from provider-visible properties and runtime does not read it; rejecting all extra keys would be broader behavior not required by this ticket. Workspace lint/test/typecheck passed: 436 files, 2211 tests.

Acceptance complete after independent re-review. Commits: cbeb998b9c799ff6daad577d7010232857968c6f (implementation) + 1052ea9ff4348fdb31d58efa2b631c42cb146d35 (deterministic regression fix). Re-review PASS: original blocking home-discovery test flaw is fixed; role-only is proven ephemeral and canonical agent wins when both keys are supplied; no compatibility path or additionalProperties:false introduced. Final workspace gates pass: lint 677 files; tests 436 files / 2212 tests; typecheck all workspaces. Decisions: canonical public selector is agent; taskType remains workflow policy; builtins are package-owned lowest-precedence definitions; test-only discovery-root seam is internal/unpublished and production defaults remain unchanged. Closed doors: no role alias/dual field, no fake builtin files, no hardcoded builtin models, no strict rejection of unrelated extra object keys.

title: Canonicalize orchestrated agent selection and ship worker/investigate defaults
